description: This header file defines classes and enums related to process information management, including process details, memory stats, process iteration, and process tree structure within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a process, including ID, priority, policy, memory stats, and methods to manipulate and retrieve process details.

classes.name: ProcessCurrent
classes.description: Derived from ProcessInfo, provides additional methods to access current process user and group information.

classes.name: ProcessTree
classes.description: Represents a tree of processes, allowing to check containment, retrieve process IDs, and get the root process ID.

classes.name: Memory
classes.description: Nested class within ProcessInfo, manages memory statistics for a process.

classes.name: Iterator
classes.description: Nested class within ProcessInfo, provides iteration over child processes based on various criteria.

methods.name: MemoryStats
methods.description: Updates memory statistics for the process.

methods.name: USS
methods.description: Returns the USS (Unique Set Size) memory usage.

methods.name: PSS
methods.description: Returns the PSS (Proportional Set Size) memory usage.

methods.name: RSS
methods.description: Returns the RSS (Resident Set Size) memory usage.

methods.name: VSS
methods.description: Returns the VSS (Virtual Set Size) memory usage.

methods.name: FindByName
methods.description: Finds processes by name and populates a list of ProcessInfo objects.

methods.name: Dump
methods.description: Sends a SIGFPE signal to the process to generate a post-mortem dump.
